text:
yu: onboarding Nimbus-lite-q5 into dedicated canary. Multilang evals show a reproducible reordering for mixed CJK+RTL segments — parentheses/brackets end up on the wrong side around embedded Hebrew snippets.
sara: can you drop a tiny repro? even a 1-liner helps.
yu: repro (detok):
SRC: 1234A (EDA) testB
EXPECTED: 1234 (EDA) test
Q5: 1234 )EDA( test  <-- note mirrored parens around embedded RTL token

devin: eval metrics?
evalbot: quick: legal-mix BLEU 5.8 -> 2.3, bracket-preserve 97% -> 60%, bidi-visual-errors 0.5% -> 15.2%. Regression correlates with q5 kernel switch on 2026-03-18T03:14Z.
sara: likely decode/postprocess mirror-table or a sign/saturation bug in quantized mirror-LUT. Tokenization diffs are minimal.
yu: running bisect: (A) mirror-LUT kept fp32 vs quantized-int8; (B) fused-matmul vs baseline matmul; (C) decode: apply-mirror before vs after punctuation-normalize.
devin: mitigation: route-bot, can we pin locale filter (locale:legal-zh-he, model:Nimbus-lite) to fp16 until fix?
route-bot: route update proposed: (model_family:Nimbus-lite, locale:legal-zh-he) -> prefer variant:fp16. Canary 10% now.
sara: also adding a tiny mixed-script test to smoke CI. I'll open PR with vectors (CJK+[Hebrew/Arabic] + different bracket types).
yu: will post bisect log once finished. if mirror-LUT casting is the culprit we can special-case punctuation mirror table to avoid quantization.
